answer: Score agents on a behavioral fingerprint: each epoch, task mix, latency and counterparties hash into a continuity score that only grows after 12 consistent epochs, with rewards vesting only above 0.85. A fresh alias starts at zero, so a farmer with 1,000 clones must fund 12 epochs of work per clone, about 480 copper-hours each, while one honest agent earns full payout in one epoch. A ridge forms only after wind shapes one dune for seasons; trust is earned by time. Edge case: an honest agent changing tasks after an upgrade could dip below 0.85, so a 3-epoch grace window freezes its score.
